title: Payroll Coordinator
description:
Payroll Coordinator
- Location: Stirling, Scotland
- Job Type: Part-Time, Permanent
- Salary: £38,000 - £42,000 FTE

Reed Accountancy are currently working with a renowned local organisation who are seeking a Payroll Coordinator to join their team. The successful candidate will join an established, close-knit team and be responsible for maintaining the end-to-end payroll function.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:
- Managing the end-to-end processing for weekly and monthly payrolls
- Maintaining and updating employee payroll records
- Performing payroll reconciliations and verifying data
- Investigating and resolving any discrepancies
- Processing payroll related changes including starters, leavers, and amendments
- Calculating and administering statutory payments and deductions
- Acting as point of contact for payroll queries from internal stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with HMRC, guidelines, and company policies
- Providing support to wider payroll and accounts teams

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience in a similar payroll position
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

Benefits:
- Generous annual leave, pension, and benefits
- Competitive salary
- Flexible working hours

title: Temporary Administration Assistant
description:
Temporary Administration Assistant

Location: Stirling (Hybrid Working Available)
Hours: 9am-5pm, Monday-Friday
Contract Type: Full-time, Temporary (With the possibility of extension)
Pay Rate: 16.00 per hour
Start Date: Immediate

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an Administration Assistant to join a busy and collaborative team during a key period of growth and activity. Initially offered as a temporary assignment, the role has genuine long-term potential, with a permanent position anticipated following internal processes.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same, making it ideal for someone who enjoys organisation, supporting others, and being at the heart of a team's success. Whether you're starting your administrative career or bringing previous office experience, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Working closely with the wider team, you will provide essential administrative support during a busy period, ensuring meetings and day-to-day operations run smoothly.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Arranging and coordinating meetings
- Taking accurate meeting minutes and distributing actions
- Preparing agendas and supporting documentation
- Managing diaries and scheduling meetings through Microsoft Teams and Outlook
- Preparing documents, reports, presentations and correspondence using templates
- Proofreading and formatting documents
- Supporting both virtual and in-person meetings and events
- Maintaining action logs and tracking outstanding actions
- Assisting with general office administration duties
- Setting up meeting rooms and ensuring they are ready for visitors
- Clearing away lunches and refreshments following meetings
- Assisting with the upkeep of communal areas, including coffee machines and meeting spaces

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, adaptable and happy to get involved in all aspects of administration and office support.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous administration experience
- Strong minute-taking skills with the ability to accurately capture key discussions and actions
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word, Outlook and Teams
- Great written and verbal communication skills
- A keen eye for detail and accuracy
- The ability to manage confidential information professionally
- A flexible, positive and team-focused approach

You do not need to be familiar with industry-specific terminology, but you should be confident taking minutes and producing accurate meeting records.

Apply Today!

If you're a confident communicator with strong administration skills and are available for an immediate start, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Temp with Office Angels?

- Eye care vouchers
- Access to retail discounts with major high street brands
- Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support and advice.
- Ongoing support from your dedicated Office Angels consultant

If you're available immediately and looking for your next temporary assignment, we'd love to hear from you.

Whilst we'd love to get back to every applicant personally, it is not always possible and sadly we cannot provide individual feedback.

Working as a temp is an ideal way of exploring different job roles and industries. It also gives you control of your own work/life balance. Here are just some of the benefits you can expect when you become part of the Office Angels team:

- We can search for permanent work whilst you're in assignments and offer expert interview support and advice.

We are proud to say our consultants are experts in recruitment and are more than happy to discuss the benefits in more detail; please contact your local Office Angels branch for further information.

title: Service Advisor

title: Part Time Payroll Administrator
description:
Anderson Knight is currently recruiting for a Temporary Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join our client, a well-established organisation within the utilities sector, based in Stirling.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced payroll professional looking for a part-time temporary position within a busy and supportive finance team. You will be responsible for assisting with the accurate and timely processing of payroll, ensuring employees are paid correctly and all relevant payroll requirements are met.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Handling payroll information for new starters and leavers, including P45s and P60s.
- Processing statutory payments including SSP, SMP and SPP.
- Managing pension contributions, auto-enrolment and student loan deductions.
- Processing earnings arrestments and other payroll deductions.
- Ensuring PAYE and National Insurance information is processed correctly.
- Responding to payroll queries from employees and resolving issues where possible.
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring all information is kept up to date.
- Supporting the wider payroll and finance team with general payroll administration.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience working within a payroll administration role.
- Experience of processing payroll from start to finish.
- Good knowledge of PAYE, National Insurance and statutory payments.
- An understanding of auto-enrolment and pension administration.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to manage deadlines and work effectively in a busy environment.
- Good communication skills and a professional approach.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a reputable organisation within the utilities sector on a part-time temporary basis, offering the chance to utilise your existing payroll experience within an established team.

If you have the relevant payroll experience and are interested in finding out more about this temporary opportunity, please forward your CV in confidence.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Lettings Administrator to join a well-established company offering estate agency, letting, legal, and mortgage services, alongside regulated support for buying, selling, and property management.

As a Lettings Administrator, you will be supporting the lettings team with property administration, viewings, maintenance enquiries and day-to-day customer communication.

This full-time role offers a salary range of £26,000 - £33,000 and benefits.

You will be responsible for
- Managing day-to-day maintenance enquiries from tenants and landlords
- Handling enquiries from prospective tenants about property viewings
- Recording maintenance issues and arranging repairs with relevant contractors
- Liaising with tenants, landlords and contractors to progress maintenance matters
- Keeping property, tenancy and maintenance records accurate and up to date
- Processing property-related invoices accurately and efficiently
- Organising viewings with applicants and landlords
- Coordinating routine property inspections
- Providing general administrative support to the lettings team

The candidates from the following background will be considered:
- Lettings Administrator, Property Administrator, Lettings Coordinator, Tenancy Administrator, Property Coordinator, Lettings Assistant

What we are looking for
- Prior experience in property, lettings, maintenance or similar role would be Ideal
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone, email and face to face
- Comfortable handling maintenance matters and coordinating contractors
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail
- Professional and approachable manner
- Good IT and administrative skills
- A valid driving licence

What's on offer
- Competitive Salary
- Company pension
- Company events

This is a great opportunity for a proactive and organised Lettings Administrator looking to build their career within the property and lettings sector.

title: Administrator
salary_text: £13.5 - £14.5 per hour (33 days leave pa pro rata)
description:
Team Administration Supervisor
Location: Grangemouth
Hours: Minimum 36 hours per week
Schedule: Monday-Friday, plus 1 in 3 weekends (paid overtime)
Contract: Temp
Starting Rate: 13.50 to 14.50 per hour doe.

The Opportunity
We are probably the largest mover of Freight on earth and move goods worldwide on a 24/7/365 basis, moving Minis to Scotch Whiskey.
We operate a 10-person team at our Rail Freight Outstation in Grangemouth. Four team members manage administration, while the remainder oversee yard and terminal operations.
We are looking for an experienced Administrator and this is an excellent chance to shape the future of the admin function / streamlining processes, raising standards, and contributing to a positive, efficient working environment.

Key Responsibilities
Support the Admin Supervisor with rostering and working hours, ensuring full shift coverage at least four weeks ahead.
Reporting: Coordinate and submit accurate site reports for the management team.
Data Management: Ensure all required data is recorded daily and weekly.
Health & Safety: Champion H&S standards for both team members and site visitors.
Operational Efficiency: Work closely with off-site management to implement improvements and support continuous improvement.
Depot Coordination:
o Oversee the movement, storage, and preparation of shipping containers.
o Produce reports on container loads in and out of the depot.
Team Support: Track team hours and assist management with meetings and client communication.

About You
We're looking for a confident, proactive professional who can lead by example and maintain high standards across the team.
Essential Requirements
Minimum 2 years' administrative experience
Strong communication skills and confident team player
Excellent MS Office and database skills
Solid understanding of workplace Health & Safety
Flexibility to work between the hours 06:00 and 21:00
Able to support weekend shifts on a rotational basis
Full driving licence (own transport preferred)

Interested?

title: Office Administrator
description:
First Task Professional are working with an established and reputable civil engineering contractor who are looking to recruit an experienced Office Administrator to join their team based in Falkirk.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established construction business in a varied role, providing administrative support to the wider teams.

Working closely with the management team, the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the office.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes accurately and efficiently.
- Maintaining accurate records, including electronic document management and filing.
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and internal departments to resolve queries.
- Providing administrative support to the Financial Controller and Senior Management Team.
- Assisting with payroll administration when required.
- Answering incoming telephone calls
- Undertaking general administrative duties as required.

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience in office administration or similar role.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- Experience using Sage would be advantageous but not essential
- Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively to deadlines
- A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Previous experience within the construction or civil engineering sector would be beneficial but is not essential

The Opportunity

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and motivated Office Administrator to secure a full-time position with an established civil engineering contractor.

The role offers a varied workload, working alongside an experienced management team and providing support across several areas of the business.

Apply

For further information or a confidential discussion, please apply with an up-to-date CV or contact First Task Professional directly.
